title: What Scripture Actually Says About Accountability (It's Not Reporting Your Sins)
caption:
Accountability that only tracks your failures will wear you out.

Scripture's version is bigger: confession that leads to healing, brothers who ask what was going on underneath, burdens carried both ways, and a phone call before the fall instead of a report after it.

Send this to the two men you'd call.

#faith #godlyman #brotherhood #accountability
